content.title: Plan: wire up Geist font in webapp
content.description: Read webapp-developer's accepted review on mqh1hkjvso (decision: wire up Geist). Plan the implementation: add `import "@fontsource-variable/geist";` to frontend/src/main.tsx (side-effect import, before ./index.css), and set `font-family: "Geist Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;` on the html, body block in the @layer base section of frontend/src/index.css. Keep system-ui in the fallback stack. Output a brief implementation plan as a comment.
